title: Callback and stream lifecycle
summary: The RPC core passes an in-process callback sink into explicitly callback-registered object methods. onNext is partial delivery. The binding owns the external stream, terminal completion/error and demand/backpressure translation. Outbound gRPC dev3 uses a polled native event path to avoid unsafe ooRexx interpreter reentry.
invariants: Every stream has at most one terminal outcome: onComplete OR onFault.
onNext before a later nonzero gRPC status is not an overall success.
Cancellation stops later delivery but cannot erase prior server effects or in-flight messages.
Backpressure, half-close and disconnection must be explicit per stream; do not silently buffer unbounded messages.
Client streaming and bidirectional streaming are NOT implemented just by passing an array to unary.
Callback failure and callback exception must be classified without leaking native exception detail.
